protocol: This file is the only grading input besides mechanically extracted features. It must not contain source_id, url, or per-source grade overrides. apply_rule() is a table lookup. A rounded or paraphrased grade is a fabrication.

unaffiliated.rule: Two sources corroborate only when registrable hosts differ AND they are not the same GitHub owner/repo.

grades.T0: PRIMARY AND EXPLICIT AND DUAL AND not REJECT
grades.T1: (MAINTAINER OR PRACTITIONER) AND EXPLICIT AND DUAL AND not REJECT
grades.T2: not REJECT AND (SINGLE corroboration OR production_claim IMPLIED) AND authority in PRIMARY,MAINTAINER,PRACTITIONER
grades.T3: RETELLER OR production_claim NONE OR leftover after T0-T2

disposition.DUPLICATE-OF: canon_key present in vendor coverage index; never re-counted as novel
disposition.UNVERIFIED: trust_grade T2 AND not DUPLICATE-OF; settling_experiment required; must not be promoted to FINDING
